title: Colours registry (data/registries/colours.json)
description: The fixed colours code draws with outside the stylesheets (MapLibre paint, canvas and SVG drawing, exported SVG, inline styles of classic scripts, contrast picks), by palette: the only place outside the token files where a colour literal may stand (docs/ARCHITECTURE-RULES.md R9). Party colours are in the parties registry's palettes part.

palettes.description: Palette id -> its readers and colours.

about.description: What reads the palette, and where.

colours.description: Role -> its colour (value), ramp (values), keyed colours (table) or named ramps (ramps). Code reads the role by name.

colour.description: A CSS colour, or a CSS value that holds colours (a text-shadow), exactly as the code used it.

table.description: Key (a shelf, a body, a role) -> colour, in the order the code lists them.

ramps.description: Ramp name -> its colours, low to high.

note.description: Why the colour is what it is, or who reads it.
